description: YouTube API: List video comments. Top-level comments of a video with author, likes, replies count, date and pinned flag. With include_replies=true each comment also carries `replies` (comment_id, parent_id, text, author, like_count, published_at), up to replies_per_comment each. Replies are billed like comments: 1 credit per 100 comments and replies together. Price: 1 credit per 100 items returned (min 1); with include_replies=true the nested items (up to replies_per_comment per item) count as items too; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

include_replies.description: Also return each comment's replies, in its `replies` list (billed like comments)

name: youtube_video_comments
title: List video comments
